text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Please listen, Trainer-san! A senior 
praised my running the other day!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"With a junior like this around, I can't 
afford to slack off!" she said!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'm getting a little closer to 
becoming Japan's best horse girl... Just 
kidding~. Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I met you, Trainer, I've come 
to love running even more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to continuing to work with 
you, Trainer!
